description: List the media partners (publishers) running on the brand's programme at Post Affiliate Pro. Use this when the user asks "who is promoting us on Post Affiliate Pro?", "which publishers are active on our programme?", or wants an outbound roster. Returns MediaPartner records with normalised status; pair with the matching get_programme_performance tool on Post Affiliate Pro to drill into per-publisher performance.
name: affiliate_post-affiliate-pro_list_media_partners
